items.headline: CPI day: September inflation lands today, the range's next trigger
items.blurb: The US September CPI print is due today (Oct 14), with the Oct 27–28 FOMC next; September's hike and hawkish minutes already reset rate expectations.
items.why_matters: A hot print could revive hike bets and pressure risk assets; a cooler one would ease the rates headwind that has weighed on ETF demand.

items.headline: BTC flat on the week near $83k after another dip toward ~$81k was bought
items.blurb: Bitcoin bounced Tuesday from the Monday-close low near $81–82k and sits around $83.2k — flat WoW and about +6.5% MoM.
items.why_matters: Repeated defence of ~$80–81k keeps the monthly uptrend intact; a CPI-driven break of $80k or $86k decides the next leg.

items.headline: BTC ETF demand still soft: Monday outflow, Tuesday tentatively green
items.blurb: US spot bitcoin ETFs completed Monday at about −$65M; Tuesday was tracking an inflow but the session was not complete at this rebuild. The last five complete sessions total about −$655M.
items.why_matters: Institutional redemptions defined last week; a run of green sessions after CPI would be the clearest sign demand is returning.

items.headline: Futures still in a Deleveraging Sell-Off as of Oct 13
items.blurb: CheckOnChain shows seven-day futures OI down about 3.1% alongside a ~2.5% price drop, with funding mild and positive.
items.why_matters: Leverage is still being cleared rather than added — less fuel for forced selling, but also less dry powder for a fast squeeze.

items.headline: RSDH stays SOL-heavy BULL; trail vs BTC widens to 0.10
items.blurb: Investorius RSDH remains SOL95/BTC5/CASH0 under a BULL macro; slow score firmed to 351 while fast eased to 31. Final× 1.22 vs BTC 1.32 — a week ago the model was 1.37 vs BTC 1.36.
items.why_matters: The model is fully invested and still slightly ahead of BTC on the month, but SOL's lag in the chop has cost it the weekly lead.
